g.text: Time per pixel: fixed work shrinks at the larger size
One worker; mean over 9 photographs of each stage's median of 7
samples after 2 warm-ups; 1:1 center crops of the same originals
at VGA 640 × 480 and FHD 1920 × 1080. Dotted lines join the same
stage boundary at the two sizes.
